values.name: score
values.label: Changed lines
values.description: Size of the ticket's merge request: additions + deletions, summed over the first two columns of `git diff --numstat -M origin/<base_branch>...HEAD` run in the ticket's worktree after `git fetch origin <base_branch>`. The three-dot form diffs against the merge base, the same diff the MR's Changes tab shows; `HEAD` because the merge deletes the remote branch; `-M` counts a rename as a rename whatever `diff.renames` says. A binary file prints `-` in both columns and counts as 0 lines but still as one file. The conductor records it when it reaps a done ticket that has an MR.

values.name: files_changed
values.label: Files changed
values.description: Number of lines in the same numstat output, binary files included.

values.name: additions
values.label: Added lines
values.description: Sum of the first numstat column (added lines), binary files as 0.

values.name: deletions
values.label: Deleted lines
values.description: Sum of the second numstat column (deleted lines), binary files as 0.
